newSchedule.title: New schedule
newSchedule.hint: Tell Claude what to do and when. It works out the timing, machine and permissions.
newSchedule.placeholder: e.g. Every weekday at 8:30, check my PRs for new review comments and reply the way we did yesterday. Ask me about anything that needs a product decision.
newSchedule.example1: Remind me to do timesheets every Friday at 4
newSchedule.example2: Watch CI on my PRs and re-run flaky jobs
newSchedule.example3: Each morning, list Slack threads waiting on me
